title: Six equivalent characterizations of a node of a 1-dimensional algebraic scheme at a closed point
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma gives six equivalent characterizations of a node (statement lines 4390-4408). The proof (lines 4410-4518) is a two-stage argument: first the complete classification over an algebraically closed field through the nondegenerate quadric xy and the Fitting-ideal presentation of Omega, then a genuine descent to arbitrary fields in which separability of kappa(x)/k, geometric reducedness of the Fitting subscheme, flat transfer of depth, and the delta-invariant inequality with its DVR contradiction each carry weight. H2: every individual step is a reference application or a short computation, but the equivalence web must be assembled in the right order and the field-extension bookkeeping is not routine.
